title: Introduce occupancy-led onboard scorer and autodraft summary
author: Anjali Rao
description:
Context and motivation: Onboarding teams repeatedly ask for a compact way to know how "occupancy" (live usage footprint of a model: active KV/cache occupancy, average context reuse, and short-term hot-prefix counts) will affect serving economics. Current model profiles capture static throughput/latency percentiles but miss transient occupancy dynamics that drive cache hit rate and batching efficiency. This PR introduces an "occupancy-led" onboarding scorer that (1) derives a small-time-window occupancy signature from sampled inference traces, (2) synthesizes a concise autodraft release summary (compact bullet-style blurb) highlighting expected cache/batching behavior and deprecation hints, and (3) wires the scorer into the onboarding pipeline so the registry stores the occupancy signature alongside existing performance profiles.

What this PR does (high-level):
- Adds a lightweight occupancy sampler and scorer that runs during model ingest or as an async probe; it produces a 6-value occupancy signature (kv_utilization_pct, avg_prefix_reuse, short_tail_hit_rate, median_kv_age, burst_index, effective_batchability) and a stability score.
- Persists the signature in the model profile document and surfaces it to the release-note autodrafter.
- Implements an autodraft summarizer that turns numeric occupancy signals into a 3-line release note: expected cache sensitivity, recommended quantization/batching knobs, and suggested deprecation/rollout guardrails.
- Exposes a read-only preview endpoint in the onboard CLI (redwood-model-registry/bin/onboard preview-occupancy) for maintainers to inspect sample traces and generated blurb before finalizing the profile.
- Adds end-to-end unit and integration tests, plus a small synthetic trace generator for CI.

Design notes and tradeoffs:
- The occupancy sampler is sampling-first (default 2% of ingests) and bounded by time/CPU to avoid adding cost to onboarding; customers can opt-out or run a full probe.
- The signature intentionally stays compact to be stable across small post-upload telemetry changes; we compute a rolling median and a stability metric to avoid noisy autodrafts.
- We avoid baking release prose into the runtime; summaries are generated and stored as part of the profile metadata and can be edited before release.

Rollout plan:
- Feature gated under feature flag registry.occupancy_autodraft=false by default.
- Canary enabled for internal models, then opt-in beta for a subset of customers.
- Observe metric: occupancy.signature_stability and autodraft.accept_rate for 2 weeks before wider enablement.

Backwards compatibility:
- No breaking schema change: new occupancy signature field is optional. Older tooling ignores it.

Implementation details (files and core changes):
- New module: onboard/occupancy/sampler.py — streaming sampler and aggregator.
- New scorer: onboard/occupancy/scorer.py — computes the 6-value signature and stability score.
- Autodraft generator: onboard/autodraft/occupancy_blurb.py — mapping logic from signature -> human-readable lines with templates.
- Persistence: model_profiles/storage.py updated to store occupancy_signature and autodraft_blurb fields, with migration shim.
- CLI preview: redwood-model-registry/bin/onboard preview-occupancy (adds small arg set).
- Tests: tests/onboard/test_occupancy_sampler.py, tests/onboard/test_autodraft_blurb.py, plus integration test harness.

Observability:
- New metrics: occupancy.sampled_requests_total, occupancy.signature_stability, autodraft.preview_requests, autodraft.generated_count.

CI and checks:
- Unit/pytest suite + lint + mypy. Synthetic trace generator added to tests/utils/trace_generator.py.
- CI initially failed on a flaky test (integration probe timing), fixed by adding deterministic seeding to the synthetic generator.

Merge notes:
- Squash-merged to main after reviewer approvals and green CI.

Release notes: see release_notes field.

Why this is different from previous profile work:
- Prior PRs focused on static throughput/latency profiling and changelog drafting based on commit history. This change ties short-term runtime occupancy heuristics directly into profile generation and creates a concise, actionable autodraft specifically about cache/batching sensitivity and rollout guardrails.

review_comments: Marco Li: Nice direction — can we make the default sample rate configurable via env var and keep the default to 0.5% for high-volume customers?

Sophie Tremblay: The autodraft prose is helpful but the templates are a bit prescriptive; prefer softer language for safety-critical models.
Author (Anjali Rao): Adjusted wording in occupancy_blurb templates to use 'recommend' and 'consider' rather than 'must' and added a flag to mark a blurb as 'suggested' in metadata.
Ethan Cole: One nit — add a unit for median_kv_age (seconds) in the profile schema and document expected units.
Author (Anjali Rao): Added units and example values to docs/onboarding/occupancy.md and schema comments.
CI: initial run failed due to flaky probe timing; updated synthetic generator determinism and re-ran — green now.
release_notes: Add occupancy-led onboarding metadata and an autodraft release summary. This introduces a compact occupancy signature to model profiles (kv_utilization_pct, avg_prefix_reuse, short_tail_hit_rate, median_kv_age_seconds, burst_index, effective_batchability) and a generated 3-line release note highlighting cache/batching sensitivity and rollout guardrails. Feature gated and off by default. Metrics: occupancy.sampled_requests_total, occupancy.signature_stability, autodraft.generated_count.
notes_for_ops: Feature is gated; enable feature flag registry.occupancy_autodraft to test. Watch occupancy.signature_stability and autodraft.accept_rate. If sampling adds overhead, reduce REGISTRY_OCCUPANCY_SAMPLE_PCT. Migration script provided scripts/migrate-add-occupancy-field.py.
qa_summary: Unit tests added and integration probe exercised with deterministic traces. Synthetic trace generator reproduces a range of burstiness profiles; manual verification performed via CLI preview on internal canary. No perf regressions observed in nightly canary cluster.
notes_confidential: Internal beta only until metrics stabilise. Do not enable feature flag for public tenants before 2025-03-05
